name: Cursed
source:
Do you believe in ghosts?

Have you ever felt as if you were being watched, only to see an empty road behind you?

Have you ever heard a voice call your name from a crowd of strangers?

Have you ever had the creeping, unsettling feeling of déjà vu?

Some may say these are nothing butsimple tricks of the mind, but in Samhain? This means you are cursed.

Whether a believer or a skeptic, one night in Samhain is sure to change your life.

Keep your wits about you...

Keep an eye over your shoulder...

And most important of all...

Trust no one.

CURSED is a short black and white horror visual novel in which you explore your childhood town of Samhain with your friend, Ellen, in order to exorcize the curses that plague it.

Equipped with a small book of folk tales, which may hide the secrets to ridding the town of curses for good, you and Ellen must find and eliminate these curses without becoming cursed yourself.

[From [url=https://adriankum.itch.io/cursed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你相信有鬼吗？

你是否曾经感觉自己被监视，却发现身后是一条空荡荡的道路？

你是否曾在一群陌生人中听到有人喊你的名字？

你有过似曾相识的感觉吗？

有些人可能会说这些不过是简单的心灵把戏，但在萨温节呢？这意味着你被诅咒了。

无论是信徒还是怀疑论者，萨温节的一晚肯定会改变你的生活。

保持你的智慧…

留意你的肩膀…

最重要的是…

没有人相信。

《CURSED》是一部简短的黑白恐怖视觉小说，你将与朋友Ellen一起探索儿时小镇Samhain，以驱除困扰该镇的诅咒。

配备了一本民间故事小书，里面可能隐藏着永久消除小镇诅咒的秘密，你和艾伦必须找到并消除这些诅咒，而自己又不被诅咒。

[来自[url=https://adriankum.itch.io/cursed]itch.io[/url]]
